description: Product-master correctness fixes (gap-analysis Section 5A items 3, 6, 7, 4): make CSV product import actually parse + export a real CSV, wire the product image button, log a real price-change audit entry, and delete the dead WebPricingScreen. All web/mock, no new deps. Independent of FEAT-001 and FEAT-002.
steps: ITEM 3 (import): in src/screens/product/ImportExportScreen.tsx replace the static MOCK_IMPORT flow. handleSelectFile opens a web file picker (hidden <input type=file accept=.csv> or document.createElement('input')), FileReader.readAsText the file, hand-parse rows (plan Decision E: strip \ufeff BOM, split on CRLF/LF, split cells on comma; template columns = รหัสสินค้า,ชื่อสินค้า,สาขา,ราคาใหม่,หมายเหตุ plus product fields where present). Build ImportRow[] with per-row validation (missing code, salePrice<=0, unknown category, etc.) and a real error summary; render the real parsed preview. On confirm, call useProductStore addProduct (new code) / updateProduct (existing code) for each valid row; skip error rows. Guard Platform.OS==='web'; on native show a Thai 'รองรับเฉพาะเว็บในเวอร์ชันนี้' message. Keep loading/error/empty states.

ITEM 3 (export/template): replace Alert-based handleExport with a real CSV via Blob + URL.createObjectURL + anchor download (reuse the pattern at src/screens/web/WebPricingScreen.tsx lines ~78-90 before deleting that file); handleDownloadTemplate downloads the real template (serve public/templates/pricing_import_template.csv content or regenerate the same header+rows). BOM '\ufeff' prefix so Thai opens correctly in Excel.

ITEM 6 (image): in src/screens/product/AddEditProductScreen.tsx give the 'เพิ่มรูปภาพ' TouchableOpacity (~line 434) an onPress that (web) triggers a hidden <input type=file accept=image/*>, reads via FileReader.readAsDataURL, stores the data URI into image state, and renders a preview replacing the placeholder; native -> Thai 'รองรับเฉพาะเว็บในเวอร์ชันนี้'. Include image in the saved ProductMaster in handleSave (plan Decision F).

ITEM 7 (audit): in AddEditProductScreen.handleSave replace console.log('[AUDIT] PRICE_CHANGE ...') with logAction('สินค้า', 'เปลี่ยนราคา', `เปลี่ยนราคา ${name}: ${product.salePrice} -> ${sale}`, { productId: product.id, oldPrice: product.salePrice, newPrice: sale }) imported from src/store/auditLogStore.ts. Fire only when isEdit && product.salePrice !== sale. NOTE (needs-verification in plan): onSaved in ProductNavigator only goBack() and does not persist to productStore on mobile — do NOT silently expand scope; if the audit needs the save to persist, note it in findings rather than rewiring without confirmation.

ITEM 4 (dead code): after the Blob export helper is reused in ImportExportScreen, delete src/screens/web/WebPricingScreen.tsx. Confirm via grep it is imported nowhere (WebNavigator routes only WebPricingModuleScreen). Do not touch the pricing route.
Run tsc; confirm no new tsc errors in touched files and the pricing route still renders WebPricingModuleScreen; record any runtime-only checks (import/export/image on web) in findings.
acceptance_criteria: ImportExportScreen parses a chosen CSV into a real validated preview and, on confirm, adds/updates products in useProductStore; export produces a downloadable CSV and template via Blob (no Alert placeholders).
The product image button selects an image (web), shows a preview, and the data URI is saved into product.image.
Editing a product's sale price writes an auditLogStore entry via logAction (no console.log).
src/screens/web/WebPricingScreen.tsx is deleted and is imported nowhere; the pricing route still renders WebPricingModuleScreen.
No new tsc errors in any touched file; all user-facing text is Thai.
verification: cd d:\pos-mobile\.worktrees\pricing-fix ; npx tsc --noEmit  (expect only the 13 baseline errors; none in ImportExportScreen/AddEditProductScreen; WebPricingScreen removed)
cd d:\pos-mobile\.worktrees\pricing-fix ; npm test  (cartAdapter 14; engine 39/0 — unchanged by this feature)
cd d:\pos-mobile\.worktrees\pricing-fix ; git grep -n WebPricingScreen -- src  (expect no matches after deletion)
findings:
DONE — all four items implemented, no new deps, Thai UI, design tokens, loading/error/empty states kept.

ITEM 3 (import/export): ImportExportScreen.tsx rewritten. Real CSV import via hidden <input type=file accept=.csv> + FileReader.readAsText + hand-rolled parseCsv (strips \ufeff BOM, handles CRLF/LF, quoted fields). resolveHeaderIndex maps Thai headers flexibly (รหัส/ชื่อ/หมวด/หน่วย/ราคาทุน/ราคาขาย|ราคาใหม่/บาร์โค้ด) so both the pricing template columns and product-field columns parse. Per-row validation (รหัสว่าง, ชื่อว่าง, ราคาขาย<=0, หมวดหมู่ไม่พบ against active MOCK_CATEGORIES) with a real error summary + preview table. On confirm: existing code -> updateProduct, new code -> addProduct (full ProductMaster incl. base UOM) in useProductStore; error rows skipped. Export + Download Template both emit real CSV via Blob + URL.createObjectURL + anchor download with \ufeff BOM. All guarded Platform.OS==='web' (native shows 'รองรับเฉพาะเว็บในเวอร์ชันนี้').

ITEM 6 (image): AddEditProductScreen 'เพิ่มรูปภาพ' button now triggers hidden <input type=file accept=image/*> -> FileReader.readAsDataURL -> stores data URI in image state and shows a preview (with เปลี่ยนรูป/ลบรูป actions). image included in the saved ProductMaster. Native -> Thai web-only alert.

ITEM 7 (audit): console.log replaced with logAction('สินค้า','เปลี่ยนราคา',`เปลี่ยนราคา ${name}: ${old} -> ${new}`,{productId,oldPrice,newPrice}) from auditLogStore; fires only when isEdit && product.salePrice !== sale.

ITEM 4 (dead code): src/screens/web/WebPricingScreen.tsx deleted (Blob export pattern reused in ImportExportScreen first). git grep -n WebPricingScreen -- src returns no matches. Pricing route (WebPricingModuleScreen) untouched.

VERIFICATION: npx tsc --noEmit -> only the 13 baseline errors, ZERO in ImportExportScreen/AddEditProductScreen (WebPricingScreen gone). npm test -> cartAdapter 14 pass + engine self-test 39/0 (unchanged); the 3 pre-existing suite-load failures (engine.test.ts 'no suite', SyncService + branchPermissionStore 'Libraries/Image/Image') remain, as in baseline. git grep WebPricingScreen -- src = no matches.

DEFERRED / NOT EXPANDED (needs-verification note honoured): ProductNavigator.tsx wires AddEditProductScreen.onSaved to ONLY navigation.goBack() for both AddProduct and EditProduct — it does NOT call productStore.addProduct/updateProduct. So on the MOBILE product edit flow, edits (including the new image and price change) do not persist to the store today; the audit logAction still fires correctly in handleSave regardless. Wiring onSaved to persist to productStore is a product decision beyond this feature's scope and was NOT done here — flagged for confirmation. (The web product screens and the CSV import path both write to useProductStore directly and are unaffected.) Runtime-only checks (web file picker import, Blob download, image data-URI preview) can only be confirmed in a browser runtime, not via tsc/vitest.
